name: rungstone
description: Offline, read-only toolkit for controls engineers: understand, check, diff, translate, verify and dependency-map PLC code across Rockwell, Siemens, CODESYS, Beckhoff, OpenPLC and IEC 61499 (4diac); lock-in reports for CODESYS/TwinCAT projects; unit tests for function blocks; extend to HMI/SCADA screens, tags and alarms; troubleshoot stops from exported historian data. Safety-rated logic is always excluded; simulation results are labelled simulated, not hardware-tested.
